chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْحُرَّةَ ثُمَّ يُعْتَقُ فَيُصِيبُ فَاحِشَةً

translations.en: Regarding a slave who marries a free woman, then is emancipated, and then commits an immoral act.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا رَجْمَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُوَاقِعَ الْحُرَّةَ بَعْدَ مَا يُعْتَقُ»

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: “There is no rajm upon him until he has intercourse with the free woman after he is emancipated.”

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَلِلْحُرَّةِ عَلَيْهِ الْخِيَارُ إِذَا أُعْتِقَ

translations.en: I said: “Does the free woman have the option concerning him when he is emancipated?”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا قَدْ رَضِيَتْ بِهِ وَ هُوَ مَمْلُوكٌ هُوَ عَلَى نِكَاحِهِ الْأَوَّلِ».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: “No. She accepted him while he was owned, and he remains upon his original marriage.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے علیہ السلام فرمایا: "نہیں۔ اس نے اسے اس وقت قبول کیا جب وہ غلام تھا، اور وہ اپنی پہلی شادی پر قائم رہتا ہے۔"
translations.tr: O, aleyhisselam şöyle buyurdu: “Hayır. O, onu köle iken kabul etti ve o, ilk nikahı üzerinde kalır.”
translations.fa: ایشان علیه السلام فرمودند: «نه. او او را در حالی که بنده بود پذیرفت و او بر نکاح اولیه‌اش باقی می‌ماند.»
translations.id: Beliau عليه السلام bersabda: “Tidak. Dia menerimanya saat dia masih menjadi milik, dan dia tetap pada pernikahan aslinya.”
translations.bn: তিনি عليه السلام বললেন: “না। সে তাকে গ্রহণ করেছিল যখন সে দাস ছিল, এবং সে তার প্রথম বিবাহের উপরই থাকে।”
translations.es: Él عليه السلام dijo: “No. Ella lo aceptó mientras él era esclavo, y él permanece en su matrimonio original.”
translations.fr: Il عليه السلام a dit : « Non. Elle l’a accepté alors qu’il était esclave, et il reste sur son mariage initial. »
translations.de: Er عليه السلام sagte: „Nein. Sie hat ihn akzeptiert, als er noch Eigentum war, und er bleibt bei seiner ursprünglichen Ehe.“
translations.ru: Он عليه السلام сказал: «Нет. Она приняла его, когда он был рабом, и он остается при своем первоначальном браке.»
translations.zh: 他说 عليه السلام:“不。她在他是奴隶时接受了他，他仍维持原先的婚姻。”

en.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a formerly enslaved man married to a free woman and the legal consequences of zinā after emancipation. It also rules that the wife does not gain a new option to dissolve the marriage merely because he was freed, since she had already accepted the marriage while he was a slave.
en.seo_question: Does a free woman have the option to leave her husband if he was a slave and later becomes emancipated?

key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: an enslaved man; here, the husband before emancipation
key_terms.الْحُرَّةَ: a free woman; here, the wife
key_terms.رَجْمَ: stoning as a legal punishment in the case under discussion
key_terms.الْخِيَارُ: the legal option or choice to continue or leave a marriage
key_terms.مَمْلُوكٌ: owned; legally in a state of slavery
key_terms.نِكَاحِهِ الْأَوَّلِ: his original marriage bond as previously contracted
